Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

751-3286-5434.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.

147-1070-6797.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-6797.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

645-1267-3899-5361.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-3899-5361.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

801-5220-5231-7855.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, adding {R}
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Impulsive Pilferer onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling Impulsive Pilferer from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from exile by paying {R}.
Repeat

4365-5660-6462-7368-7824.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2103-4477-7370.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from exile to the battlefield.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2557-3510-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2557-3510-5702.description:
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-4661.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Evil Twin and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

339-677-6797-7730.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1939-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-5641-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2313-3099-4762-4772.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doubling Season and Conclave Mentor.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

3525-7008.easyPrerequisites: You control an untapped land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
3525-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying {1}{G}, When it enters, its first ability triggers, earthbending a land that can produce at least {U}.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to the earthbent land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Badgermole Cub's second ability triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping the land.
Repeat from step 3.
3525-7008.notes: If the land adds more than one mana on its own, then you may also get other types and/or colors of mana as a result of this combo.

560-1274-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-1274-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1358-3129-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1086-3490-4017-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1086-3490-4017-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

141-2596-5231.description:
Cast Living Death by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Living Death.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Living Death
Resolve the Living Death copy, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, and returning all cards exiled this way to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat from step 3.

826-2178-5147-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

189-5909.description:
Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters, it triggers, causing each player to exile all but the bottom six cards of their library.
Cast One Ring to Rule Them All by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When One Ring to Rule Them All enters, its first chapter ability triggers, causing Doomsday Excruciator to become your Ring-bearer and causing each opponent to mill the rest of their library.

1170-1414-4211-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.

Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.

Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

Activate Experiment Kraj using Gyre Sage's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

222-413-527-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2816-4667.easyPrerequisites:
Elvish Aberration does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Elvish Aberration.
2816-4667.description:
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Elvish Aberration by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3698-4493-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication
3698-4493-5365.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat from step 2.
3698-4493-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

1939-2577-5670.notablePrerequisites:
Lunarch Veteran can be on the battlefield transformed.
Your life total is at least 2.
1939-2577-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it is on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it is on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1409-2079-2933-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-2079-2933-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1247-4474-4613-5467.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1247-4474-4613-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it, adding {1}.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Activate Wylie Duke using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1947-2136-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
1947-2136-2178.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Reckless Barbarian with haste.
Activate the five Reckless Barbarian tokens by sacrificing them, adding ten {R}.
When the Reckless Barbarian tokens die, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Reckless Barbarian tokens and/or target any other creature.

1110-1981-3333.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1110-1981-3333.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage to you equal to the creature's power, with your life total not changing due to Platinum Emperion.
Darien triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the damage dealt to you.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to you, with your life total not changing due to Platinum Emperion.
Repeat from step 3.

169-1849-2825-3152.notablePrerequisites:
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
169-1849-2825-3152.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {0} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pact of the Titan without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Resolve Pact of the Titan, creating a 4/4 Giant creature token.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Deal combat damage to each opponent using the Giants, causing them to lose the game due to having zero or less life.

57-232-2178-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-232-2178-4659.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {C}{C}.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Feldon triggers, untapping Feldon.
Repeat.

913-1350-2713-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin twice by paying {2}, giving any two creatures trample until end of turn.
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}, giving any creature trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {W}, returning Soulbright Flamekin from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

4499-5296.description:
Remove 3 +1/+1 counters from Workhorse to add {3}.
Activate Emiel to exile Workhorse and return it to the battlefield with 4 counters.
Repeat.

589-2428-2919.notablePrerequisites: Fathom Mage's power is 2 or less.
589-2428-2919.description:
Cast Horizon Chimera by paying {2}{G}{U}.
Horizon Chimera enters the battlefield, triggering Fathom Mage.
Resolve Fathom Mage's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage and drawing a card.
Horizon Chimera triggers, gaining you 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.
